reviews.review_text:
Graham W
Aberdeen, United Kingdom23 contributions
0
Traditional Hanoi Food
Sep 2026 • Couples
We recently dined at Red Bean Restaurant in the La Siesta Ma May Hotel, and it was great from start to finish.
We began with the assorted rolls as a starter, which set a high bar for the evening. Everything was fresh, light, and packed with fragrant flavours. For the mains, I had the beef served in a coconut, which was full of flavour, while my wife had the Hanoi-style grilled pork, which was the star of the show.
A special mention goes out to our server, Cho. She made us feel incredibly welcome right from the moment we sat down and took care of us throughout the night.
If you are looking for fresh, delicious, authentic Vietnamese cuisine in Hanoi, Red Bean is a must-visit.

After dining you can head up to the rooftop Moonlight Sky Bar.
